description: Documenting historic buildings damaged by the Quadstate tornadoes in December 2021 is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Rebecca Napolitano, Penn State University (psu.edu). The 2021 Quad State Tornado outbreak, an EF-4 event with a path length exceeding 250 miles and wind speeds over 190 mph, provided a unique opportunity to assess the performance of historic buildings across multiple states in the American Midwest. Coverage: Kentucky. DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 2 top-level files (XLSX). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-7xm0-e324. Keywords: Tornado, Historic Buildings. Published 2024-10-09. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
